header: XMS Service Bus messaging - core.MDM_RECORD / core.MDM_PROJECTION
notes: The generic MDM registry. MDM_RECORD is the system of record for
microservice-supplied identity; SAT MICROSERVICE_ columns are a projection
of it, re-derived on every sp_ApplyEventInbox run.

objects.name: MDM_RECORD
objects.description: Generic MDM registry - system of record for microservice-supplied identity, keyed (EntityName, IntegrationSrc, BusinessKey)

objects.name: MDM_PROJECTION
objects.description: MDM projection rules - maps canonical registry fields to SAT MICROSERVICE_ columns; wildcard EntityName star applies to all entities
